---
name: Lesson improvement
about: Suggest a clearer, safer, or more accurate way to teach a Git concept
title: "[Lesson]: "
labels: lesson
---

## Lesson or page

Link the lesson or name the module.

## What was unclear, inaccurate, or missing?

Explain it as a learner would experience it.

## What would make it better?

Share suggested wording, an example, or a scenario. Technical accuracy matters: please include sources or commands when useful.

## Who would this help?

For example: first-time Git users, visual learners, keyboard users, or people recovering from a merge conflict.
